tool.name: BioNym ask
tool.description: ask a free-form question over a BioNym knowledge graph
tool.command: ## per-job cache keeps API/JEV responses across retries within this job export BIONYM_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/.bionym_cache" && #if $adv.llm_model: export LLM_MODEL="$adv.llm_model.fields.model_id" && export LLM_PROVIDER="$adv.llm_model.fields.provider" && #end if ## hub fallback: resolve LLM endpoint+key from LITELLM_CONFIG_FILE when no ## credential/env is set (shared one-liner — see macros.xml @LITELLM_FALLBACK@) @LITELLM_FALLBACK@ && bionym ask '$graph' '$question' #if str($test_mode) == 'true': --mock-jev --mock-llm #end if > '$answer'

param.name: question
param.label: Question
param.help: Free-form question answered over the graph: JEV buckets it into graph categories, the LLM answers over that slice, JEV scores accuracy and completeness. Questions outside the categories are answered unscored with a warning.

param.name: question
param.value: What is known about this gene?

tool.help:
Ask a free-form question over an existing **BioNym resolve** graph JSON.
The judge (JEV) first buckets the question into the graph's evidence categories; the configured LLM then answers over just that slice of the graph, and JEV scores the answer's accuracy and completeness. Questions that fall outside the categories are still answered, unscored, with a warning. Node IDs the answer cites are listed after the answer text, with any invalid (not-in-graph) citations flagged.
*User → Preferences → Credentials Management* — the judge credential is required, and an LLM credential (or an admin-provided LiteLLM endpoint via ``LITELLM_CONFIG_FILE`` or destination env) is required for real answers.
